name: Epic (chain)
mechanic: Doubles the chance of Legendary cards appearing.

name: Escalating reroll cost
mechanic: Shop reroll/refresh costs increase with each use.

name: Escape Artist / Stuntsman class
mechanic: Class mechanical focus: negative-effects (debuffs).

name: Escaramuza formation bonus
mechanic: A synchronized-formation bonus for symmetrical board states.

name: Event-recycled prestige
mechanic: An in-run event grants temporary prestige points to allocate, reusing the meta-progression system mid-run.

name: Every deck as its own solitaire board
mechanic: Vetoed: making every deck (draw/discard/rule) itself a playable solitaire board with no layout control, leading to unsolvable boards.

name: Exchange Voucher
mechanic: Usable from the deck: swap it with any card currently on screen.

name: Exponential price curve
mechanic: Card power/cost sits on an exponential curve: stronger cards are priced cheaper than linear scaling would suggest, since high cost trades off against flexibility.

name: Exposition City
mechanic: An enormous once-per-map goal where every suit is welcomed.

name: Exposure cost
mechanic: Revealing a Gaff's true nature (the player's own or a boss's) carries a cost.

name: Eye of God
mechanic: See all decks (including the rule deck) and their true descriptions.

name: Eye of God true vision
mechanic: A prestige unlock grants 'true vision': seeing all decks (including the rule deck) and true card descriptions.

name: Eye stamp mini-art
mechanic: The hidden-trigger (eye) stamp shows a miniature of the card's skill art inside the stamp icon.

name: Face/heel alignment
mechanic: Cards have face/heel modes with different bonuses; towns prefer one alignment or the other.

name: Fairy Floss
mechanic: When scored, adjacent cards gain +1 rank for this show.

name: Fame as antagonist reframe
mechanic: Rename the goal score to 'Fame needed'; overscore grants tips; no separate enemy HP is added.

name: Fame banks at Continue
mechanic: Fame is only committed when the player presses Continue after a win, not at the outcome screen itself, so a win stays undoable until then.

name: Fame gates pack rarity
mechanic: Accumulated fame raises a run-wide luck value that gates stamp/skill/type rolls in packs.

name: Fame improves offer rarity
mechanic: Total accumulated fame improves the rarity odds of card offers.

name: Fame/tips framing
mechanic: Scoring represents exciting the audience; cheering audio scales with score; overscoring pays out tips; the required score is the fame the show must earn.

name: Family-tent deck
mechanic: Starts weak, but gains a permanent heirloom card each finished tour.

source: DESIGN_REFERENCES.md §A8 Middle East, Central Asia, Mongolia
name: Festival mini-contest node
mechanic: Win any 1 of 3 mini-contests (score/formation/speed) for the prize.

name: Final Act
mechanic: Deck-position type: shows up after all other cards are drawn, possibly carrying an extra multiplier.

name: Fire breather
mechanic: Projects a Flames buff across an entire row, then Exhausts itself.

name: Fire = Burning status
mechanic: Fire drops a Burning status on its target, multiplying that card's own suit-effect prop count.

name: Fire-knife dual-suit pip
mechanic: A pip counting as both Knives and Flames suits simultaneously.

name: Fireworks suit (proposed)
mechanic: Fireworks suit directly adds points to its column based on rank.

name: First Act
mechanic: Deck-position type: shows up alone, before any other cards are drawn.

name: First of May
mechanic: A rookie joins: gain a random Common card with a hidden growth condition that upgrades it after scoring 10 times.

name: First / Second / Final Act (type entry)
mechanic: Deck-position control types (see §11 Act types).

name: Flash
mechanic: Scores triple points, but only the first time it would ever score, once per show.

name: Flea Circus
mechanic: Scores as if it were 5 cards of rank 1, for combo-counting purposes.

name: Flooded rows
mechanic: Water-covered rows let cards float (move freely sideways) while the cards beneath stay hidden but active.

name: Flyer & catcher system
mechanic: The Flyer card can be 'thrown' to any column containing the Catcher card.

name: Fog of war on choices
mechanic: Fog of war obscures further map choices ahead, themed as 'going on tour.'

name: Fog-of-war route arrows
mechanic: Arrow markers stay visible on map edges the player has already scouted.

name: Fool's License
mechanic: Ignore one rule card of the player's choice while this card is spotlit.

name: Foot of God
mechanic: Switch locations with any card currently on screen.

name: Forbidden-solitaire event mode
mechanic: An event mode variant where clicking cards sends them directly to the player's hand.

name: Force-trigger via stacking
mechanic: A card that force-triggers a linked on-trigger card whenever it is tapped via stacking; judged probably too hard to implement well.

name: Formation alt win cons (rejected)
mechanic: Rejected: alt win conditions tied to formations, since a crafted deck can guarantee the formation every time.

name: Fortune Teller class
mechanic: Class mechanical focus: deck manipulation.

name: Forward somersault (Con Colleano)
mechanic: Flip a card over the one directly above it (swap upward).

name: Friendly Acrobat town
mechanic: Acrobat cards cost less here, and acrobat packs are guaranteed.

name: FTL constellation map
mechanic: A constellation/DAG map with no backtracking; touring city to city builds fame; environmental hazards and surprise weather occur en route.

name: Gambler leader (Poker Alice)
mechanic: A leader built for a casino-flavored deck.

name: Genie's Wish
mechanic: Choose a card to create a copy of in the player's hand.

name: Gentleman juggling
mechanic: Prop (non-feat) cards in this card's row count as Balls suit.

name: Gentling
mechanic: Animal cards can be buffed into loyalty instead of being consumed, as an alternative to eating mechanics.

name: Ghost Card (summary)
mechanic: Doesn't block Spotlight for cards beneath it.

name: Glass
mechanic: Scores double points, but is destroyed (shatters) after being scored 3 times.

name: Goal curve formula
mechanic: Show goals follow G0 x (N-hat/N0)^ALPHA x difficulty x BOSS x LAP^lap, baked per progress step with a monotone clamp.

name: Gold card
mechanic: Money-token card; heavy, so it always sinks to the bottom of the deck.

name: Gold suit
mechanic: A literal money suit, playable as a normal suit as well as functioning as currency.

name: Gold token cards
mechanic: Gold cards are heavy token cards minted by Producer-class effects or money-on-trigger stamps.

name: Grand Spec
mechanic: If all columns scored this submit, double the show's combo.

source: DESIGN_REFERENCES.md §A8 Middle East, Central Asia, Mongolia
name: Gym node (Zurkhaneh)
mechanic: Permanently +1 rank to one card; chivalry rule: only applies if that card has never been used to destroy another card.

name: Half-step rank
mechanic: Rank of 5½ (etc.): stacks between 5 and 6 in a run but can never meld into a poker hand.

name: Hall of Mirrors
mechanic: The boss show duplicates the board's reflection with fake copies (Gaffs) of the player's cards to play around.

name: Halo charge display
mechanic: The halo doesn't resize but gains black divider lines to show remaining charge uses.

name: Handicap flourish
mechanic: Voluntarily debuff this card's move for double its score.

name: Harlequin pip
mechanic: Dual-suit pip: counts as two suits at once for scoring purposes.

name: Head of state attends
mechanic: Pass the show to permanently raise the fame floor.

name: Heat as second currency
mechanic: Heel shows earn heat instead of fame; some towns pay more for a villain.

name: Heavy
mechanic: Sinks to the bottom of the deck after shuffling.

name: Held-button full description
mechanic: Reading a card's full description requires holding a button or an info toggle (also applies in deck/pack viewers).

name: Helium Card
mechanic: Named version of the Light material: rises during Next.

name: Hey Rube! (boss)
mechanic: Each submit, the rightmost column is attacked: cards there are debuffed unless guarded by a Stuntsman/Strongman card.

name: Hidden bearers (costaleros)
mechanic: Covered cards beneath a scoring card add their ranks to it.

name: Hidden-identity reveal cards
mechanic: Identity/rarity is revealed only after N scores, as a fanfare moment.

name: Hidden micro-text art
mechanic: A card's art contains legible hidden micro-text.

name: Hidden Rules Deck
mechanic: A normally-hidden Rules Deck holds cards that define the default ruleset (stacking, scoring, input/zone counts, draw-on-Next); changing the ruleset means changing cards in this deck.

name: High-score luck gates
mechanic: Progress is gated behind occasional extreme high scores that demand luck or complicated decks, pushing toward dynamic, animated builds.

name: Hippodrome factions
mechanic: Each show, an audience faction favors one suit; ignoring them too long spawns a Riot boss.

name: Hire a claque
mechanic: Guarantees minimum fame this show, but demands payment at every subsequent show.

name: History-driven strike/tax events
mechanic: Run behavior triggers events: sacrificing too many talents causes a union strike; hoarding too many cards causes tax evasion (lose a portion of basic cards).

name: HONK
mechanic: On cue (tap), makes a honk noise; unlimited uses.

name: Hoop tower
mechanic: Consecutive same-suit hoop cards multiply their score.

name: Houses
mechanic: Cards belong to named houses with Mother/leader cards; category walks are judged-show scoring events.

name: Hundred Entertainments deck
mechanic: A 100-card variant deck of all commons, focused on combo scoring.

name: Hype mechanic
mechanic: Voluntarily double the fame required for the next show in exchange for better goodies.

name: Illegal stack submission spot
mechanic: Early rule: an illegal stack could only be placed on the submission spot (removed with the loop v2 rewrite).

name: Immovable (unnamed)
mechanic: Type that resists being moved once placed.

name: Improving town (Chautauqua)
mechanic: No Danger acts allowed, but Concessions/education-tagged cards score double.

name: Incoming card mulligan
mechanic: Incoming cards can be mulliganed via a click + discard button before dropping.

name: Incoming card rearrange
mechanic: Incoming cards can be rearranged before they drop into play.

name: Input
mechanic: Zone-header type: on Next, drops its held stack to the paired lower column, then draws a new card.

name: Input Adder (upper)
mechanic: Adds 1 Entrance input column per copy in the rule deck.

name: Inverted-blessing naming
mechanic: Debuff-granting cards carry well-wishing names, and vice versa.

name: Jack-of-all-trades
mechanic: Counts as every class at once, but at half effect (masters none).

name: Jaded city (Richiardi)
mechanic: Only shock (Danger/negative) acts impress here; a horror-show variant scoring rule applies.

name: Jaded fear-show town
mechanic: Debuff-inflicting cards are the headliners in fear shows.

name: John Robinson (elite)
mechanic: Shortened show: 2 submits instead of 3.

name: Judged-category scoring
mechanic: Some shows grade formation, suit variety, and stamps as separate scored categories instead of one total.

name: Judged festival (City Dionysia)
mechanic: Scores in separate categories (best formation/suit spread/single meld) instead of one total.

name: Juggler leader (Rastelli)
mechanic: Balls-suit cards can be kept aloft (re-scored) as long as one scores each submit.

name: Jump/duck reactions
mechanic: Feat cards dynamically jump up through hoops and duck under knives as projectiles pass.

name: Karuta duel
mechanic: A speed-pick minigame where the first click rewards.

name: Kneeling Devil
mechanic: A negative-effect card that, if kept a full tour, converts into a positive card at the final city.

name: Knife suit
mechanic: Mirrors Hoop but launches from the opposite row side and scores plain (prop) cards instead of talents.

name: Knives/Hoops horizontal projectiles
mechanic: Scored knife and hoop cards fly horizontally across their scored row; balls and fire drop down columns.

name: Kuroko
mechanic: This card is 'unseen': doesn't block Spotlight, can't be targeted by bosses.

name: Label / Evident
mechanic: Announces its rule-deck effect on the board even while the rule deck stays hidden.

name: Label/Evident card
mechanic: A card announces its rule-deck effect on the board while the rule deck itself stays hidden ('Baba Is You' visibility trick).

name: Lazzi trigger-macros
mechanic: Equippable trigger-macros: small scripted combos a card can rehearse.

name: Leader (type entry)
mechanic: Type that starts a card on the board or in the Entrance and boosts its group.

name: Leader chassis
mechanic: Leader cards start already on the board (or in the Entrance) and do not leave play on submit; different starting decks ship different leaders.

name: Leader elemental fears
mechanic: Optional debuff: some leaders fear fire/knives and cannot be placed on fire/knife cards.

name: Leader group boost
mechanic: Cards belong to groups/classes, and leader cards boost their group.

name: Leader lineage succession
mechanic: Retiring a maxed leader unlocks its heir with a carried-over power.

name: Liberty Horses
mechanic: On Next, all Animal-tagged cards in the Entrance rearrange themselves into ascending order.

name: Light
mechanic: Rises to the top of the deck (counterpart to Heavy, never built).

name: Literal spotlight beam
mechanic: Triggering cards get a literal spotlight beam instead of a generic glow; the whole screen may dim during submit.

name: Lithograph
mechanic: While in the Entrance (not the Ring), broadcasts its skill globally.

name: Live undo during resolution
mechanic: Pressing Undo during a resolving act cancels it: the resolution fast-forwards and the pre-act board state restores, with no act consumed.

name: Lore scraps unlock
mechanic: Wins/actions unlock lore scraps.

name: Mabel's Tigers
mechanic: Consumes the card it's dropped on (like Gluttony) but only prop cards; +rank per meal.

name: Magic deck
mechanic: Each suit is an element; submitting elemental combinations casts spells.

name: Magician class
mechanic: Class mechanical focus: card creation and deletion.

name: Magician leader (Tenkatsu)
mechanic: Produces token cards.

name: Mana cards
mechanic: Any card can serve as a resource instead of an abstract mana bar.

name: Mancala targeting
mechanic: Ball/Fire projectiles are ballistic: a mancala walk down the column picks a fixed count of talent targets at spawn; Fire's eligibility skips talents and other Fire props.

name: Map alternative topologies
mechanic: Alternatives considered: no final city (circle the map), must return to start, or visited points become revisitable after enough time passes.

name: Map click seeds next drop
mechanic: Clicking a map card made it the first card dropped in the next match.

name: MapNodeRoles
mechanic: Deterministically assigns show/booster/anchor roles to map nodes from the run seed.

name: Marked stamp
mechanic: The player always knows where this card currently sits in the deck.

name: Marketed monster
mechanic: Terrifies (debuffs) adjacent cards while secretly being a gentle Humbug.

name: Masked satire (Talchum)
mechanic: Heat (infamy) is earned safely because a mask absorbs the town's anger.

name: Maximum Effort / Exhaust
mechanic: Double (or flat bonus) points from this card on score; only refreshes if the card is NOT played/scored the following show.

name: Meal call (cookhouse flag)
mechanic: A mid-tour rest tick heals one debuff per card, once per region.

name: Mid-show instant tips
mechanic: Overscoring a single meld pays out instantly instead of at show end.

name: Milk Can
mechanic: Cue: place a card inside; it leaves play; retrieve it any later turn.

name: Minesweeper board
mechanic: Full deck laid face-down; only cards adjacent to a revealed card can be clicked; clicking triggers a battle for that card and reveals its neighbors; win by uncovering all cards.

name: Mini-game score-free events
mechanic: Some encounters replace score-to-win with alternate win-con puzzles, e.g. 'trigger 5 times to win.'

name: Misdirection theft
mechanic: When the biggest meld of a submit scores, a pickpocket event may trigger, or a card steals from the town for bonus gold.

name: Misrule show
mechanic: For one show, all ranks are reversed (2 counts high, King counts low); winning it pays huge tips.

name: Mobile pageant zone
mechanic: A zone/column relocates each turn.

name: Mock the Booking
mechanic: Reduce the declared Booking goal once per tour.

name: Modifier-driven grab/place legality
mechanic: Stacking legality is decided by a resolver pass: all cards' allow/deny effects are gathered into a whitelist and blacklist, with the blacklist winning over the whitelist.

name: Money on Trigger
mechanic: Gain money whenever the card triggers.

name: Moonstruck (Pierrot)
mechanic: Buffs on alternating ('night') shows, pines (does nothing/less) otherwise.

name: Mountebank tonics
mechanic: Cheap buffs with a chance of doing nothing (being water).

name: Movement-resistant cards
mechanic: Cards that resist being moved once placed.

name: Mud Show
mechanic: Picking up any stack costs 1 discard.

name: Mystery Box
mechanic: On game start, becomes a random skill.

name: Named court card identities
mechanic: Face cards have hidden historical identities discoverable through play; uncovering all 12 grants a meta reward.

name: Negative weather effects
mechanic: Weather events impose negative effects, framed as 'the show must go on.'

name: New scoring methods
mechanic: Skill taxonomy category: cards that create new ways to score.

name: No-conditions cue
mechanic: This card's cue works with zero requirements, from anywhere.

name: Nominal suit subclasses
mechanic: Each suit is a nominal PipSuit subclass (Hoop/Knife/Ball/Fire/Firework) with no ordinal value, constructed explicitly rather than compared by index.

name: Null cards
mechanic: Null cards take up space on the board and are highlighted when selected so hovering over null space reads clearly.

name: Odd couple buff
mechanic: The thinnest (lowest rank) and heaviest (highest rank) card in a row buff each other.

name: OG Grabber
mechanic: Provides the default grab legality: ascending/descending runs, no same-suit stacking.

name: OG Placer
mechanic: Provides the default placement legality rule.

name: One-upmanship duel (scissors dance)
mechanic: Alternate melds with a rival, each must out-score the last; first to fall short loses everything wagered.

name: Only first poker hand scores
mechanic: Only the first (best) scored poker hand on a row actually scores; later poker hands on the same line are ignored.

name: Only legal stacks liftable
mechanic: Only legal stacks can be picked up at all, making moving stacks harder as the run progresses.

name: Out-of-game ARG secret
mechanic: A mystery solvable only through outside research.

name: Outcast Troupe deck
mechanic: Cheaper everywhere but banned from rich towns; built from exactly six classes (one per Namsadang art).

name: Outlawed cards
mechanic: Cards banned in pious towns (cannot score there) but score double in others; persecution can spawn an underground-shows event chain.

name: Overscore tax retired
mechanic: The overscore tax was retired: wins now bank the full score as fame with no separate penalty.

name: Overscoring ramps requirements
mechanic: Overscoring ramps up future score requirements, so the player balances declaring a big score (fame wagering) against the risk of missing it.

name: Paired giants
mechanic: Each of a pair gets +mult while both are on the board.

name: Panem et circenses free show
mechanic: Give a free show: zero gold earned, big fame gain, town loyalty increased.

name: Panorama consumable
mechanic: Reveals the whole map's silhouette.

name: Paper
mechanic: Default/basic material with no special effect.

name: Peanut Pitch
mechanic: Cue (3 charges): add points to any one card, thrown from anywhere.

name: Peek-over presentation
mechanic: Cards with skills idly move and peek over the card blocking them; blocked active cards shift the row below to show at least their upper art half.

name: Pepper's Ghost
mechanic: An intangible duplicate of one card appears in the opposite zone; scores as if real but can't be touched or attacked.

name: Per-act score multiplier
mechanic: Each act (or only the final act) could carry an increasing score multiplier.

name: Per-card personal bests
mechanic: Personal bests are recorded on the card itself; beating one's own record fires a fame event.

name: Per-level rule deck
mechanic: Rejected: replacing the rule deck with a per-level deck, since score goals live outside the rule deck and building UI from it is scope creep.

name: Per-meld suit firing
mechanic: A scored card's suit effect fires once per meld membership (once for its row, once for its column); talented (skill-bearing) cards suppress their own suit effect.

name: Per-scenario rule decks
mechanic: Game rules determine what Next and Submit do; different scenarios swap in different rule decks, and edits during a run are permanent for that run.

name: Performance Rings (origin)
mechanic: Every 5 rows scored increases points 'by layer' / turns the row red — the seed idea that became Performance Rings.

name: Performance Rings
mechanic: Score zones by board depth: the First Ring (rows 1-5) scores at 1x, rows 6-10 at 2x, rows 11-15 at 3x, and so on, enabling effects keyed to reaching outer rings.

name: Performance Rings as depth multiplier
mechanic: Performance Rings act as multipliers on the column combo specifically, rewarding tall play.

name: Permanent-toggle effect archetype
mechanic: An effect archetype that, once activated, stays active for the rest of the game and can never be toggled off again.

name: Persistent spin-buff (Sangmo)
mechanic: A spin-buff persists as long as the combo continues.

name: Pip comparator resolver
mechanic: A pip resolver/comparator class governs all rank/suit comparisons; card mods are asked first (on_compare_ranks/suits) with numeric fallback.

name: Pip-registered scoring methods
mechanic: Each pip class can register its own static scoring methods as defaults for that pip; pip effects are permanently active, unlike skills.

name: Player-editable rule deck
mechanic: Metagame idea: the player can modify the ruleset deck during a run by adding or removing default cards.

name: Poker Crown (unnamed)
mechanic: When scored, this card and the 4 cards above it are scored together as a poker hand.

name: Poker Evaluator
mechanic: Performs best-poker-hand evaluation per line.

name: Power-sort rarity
mechanic: Rarity is determined by how far a base effect has been power-climbed into a stronger version of the same idea (e.g. Hippo to Sin of Gluttony).

name: Pre-show challenge dance
mechanic: Sacrifice a turn to open with an intimidation display that lowers the fame goal.

name: Presentation
mechanic: Moving cards into ascending order gives multiplier points.

name: Press Bribery / Memory Wipe
mechanic: Extra life: on failing a city, keep going as if the player had won; possibly a straight win if held to the end.

name: Prestige meta-shop
mechanic: Wins grant prestige currency spent in the Carnival meta-shop on map odds, starting resources, true vision, guaranteed cards/packs, a full unlock reset, or the custom deck editor; spending raises per-show score requirements.

name: Producer / Manager class
mechanic: Class mechanical focus: token cards — gold/money cards and basic cards.

name: Projectile hit/miss bonuses
mechanic: Gain mult for every hoop passing through an animal or acrobat, every knife missing a stuntsman, every ball hitting a juggler or animal; fire buffs cards it passes through.

name: Prop-vs-feat suit targeting
mechanic: Knives reward hitting non-feat (prop) cards, hoops reward hitting feat cards; balls buff feat cards, fire buffs non-feat cards, with balls/fire spreading buffs evenly across the column.

name: Psycho
mechanic: An Automaton card plays a card from the deck by itself every Next.

name: Punch
mechanic: Beats adjacent cards for points.

name: Punk / Minimal unlockable decks
mechanic: A Punk deck (rule-breaking commons, no Producer class) and a Minimal deck (pips only) as unlockable philosophies.

name: Quests (TFT-style)
mechanic: Extremely random conditions cause permanent effects, emphasizing unlocking; effects upgrade themselves into better versions when conditions are met.

name: Quick-change (Hikinuki)
mechanic: On scoring, swap this card's stamp with any stamp in reserve.

name: Railroad Jump (route hazard)
mechanic: Traveling a long map edge costs a card from the deck (left behind on the platform).

name: Random standard suit roster
mechanic: The standard random suit roster is [Hoop, Knife, Ball, Fire]; Firework is excluded from random rolls and instead rises up its column, banking column score at the top.

name: Rare (chain)
mechanic: Doubles the chance of Epic cards appearing.

name: Rarity visual tiers
mechanic: Different rarities get different borders, shines, and possibly holographic effects.

name: Removing unwanted cards
mechanic: Skill taxonomy category: cards that remove unwanted cards.

name: Repositioning
mechanic: Skill taxonomy category: cards that reposition cards on the board.

name: Reroll Blessing effect archetype
mechanic: +1 reroll per game; repeated actions will not repeat the same results for the rest of the game.

name: Residency mode
mechanic: An alternate endless mode where the player stays in one evolving city instead of circling the map.

name: Resort towns
mechanic: Lower goals, better shops, no bosses.

name: Revealing (Eye)
mechanic: Card triggers even when hidden/covered.

name: Ringmaster
mechanic: No suit/rank; starts in the Entrance; always grabbable; can be placed anywhere uncovered; survives submission.

name: Ringmaster leader spec
mechanic: No suit or rank; type starts it in the Entrance; stamp lets it always be picked up and placed anywhere uncovered; skill keeps it on board after submission.

name: Roman numeral rank
mechanic: Cosmetic rank skin; melds identically to a normal rank.

name: Rookie growth cards
mechanic: Rookie commons with growth conditions that upgrade them over time.

name: Rosin
mechanic: Cards placed on it cannot be picked up again, but score +1 per ring depth when scored.

name: Rotation re-trigger naming / fail-to-unlock
mechanic: Re-trigger counts are named as rotations; a card must publicly fail N times before unlocking its true form.

name: Route-as-song bonus
mechanic: Repeating a traveled route pattern 'in the right order' grants a strengthening bonus.

name: Route-length achievements
mechanic: Achievements for total walked/traveled map distance.

name: Row-then-column evaluation order
mechanic: Evaluation proceeds top-down: poker hands are scored first, with each column's run calculated simultaneously as that row resolves; refined to score all rows first, then all lanes simultaneously at that row.

name: Row x column aggregation
mechanic: All vertical (column) scores are multiplied together with all horizontal (row) scores at the end of a submit.

name: Rule cards as a type
mechanic: Rule cards are not special: they are a card type whose skill is 'always global spotlight'; other types can define 'return to deck X when Y.'

name: Rule cards get random pips
mechanic: Rule cards are given a random suit and rank in case a player ever extracts one into normal play.

name: Rules-in-hand deck
mechanic: Rule deck is empty; all rules are shuffled into the main deck.

name: Rules-in-hand deck variant
mechanic: A deck variant where the rule deck is empty and all rules are shuffled into and drawn from the main deck.

name: Run the monte (thrower)
mechanic: Play the monte-thrower role yourself for gold, risking town reputation.

name: Séance Night
mechanic: Pick the Gaff out of 3 face-down cards for a reward.

name: Sacred juggling (Daikagura)
mechanic: Balls-suit scoring removes one debuff per juggling meld.

name: Satirical Animal Trainer leader
mechanic: Satire angers towns (fame up, town relations down); pigs can mock the Booking.

name: Sawdust
mechanic: When discarded, leaves a marker on its board slot; the next card placed there gets +points.

name: Scan deck/discard for scoring
mechanic: Open idea: scoring could also scan the draw deck and discard pile, not just the board.

name: Score goal per-layer increment
mechanic: Score goal increments per match, currently x1.1 per layer.

name: Score slots
mechanic: Score slots on the right score whatever is placed on them and double as free spaces between deck clicks.

name: Scripted clown combos
mechanic: Clown combos are scripted sequences (lazzi) with an end-of-sequence bonus.

source: DESIGN_RECOMMENDATIONS.md §1 How I read your design
name: Searing Knife (adopt)
mechanic: Column hazard card enables town/boss content around knife scoring.

name: Searing Knife (summary)
mechanic: On score, burns its column, locking it for 2 turns.

name: Seasonal crown
mechanic: A per-season champion title (Calypso Monarch); extempo joins the verse-duel family.

name: Second Act
mechanic: Deck-position type: shows up alone after half the deck has been drawn.

name: Secret meld unlocks new rules
mechanic: Cards can carry secret on-add-to-deck effects that add entirely new rules once discovered.

name: Self-granted title
mechanic: A card names itself Rare, counting as one rarity higher for effect purposes only (not for drop pools).

name: Seven Pyramid
mechanic: A 7-card stack formation meld with a huge payout.

name: Shared charge system
mechanic: All charge-based effects share one charge system so charges can be gained/lost from any source; unused charges auto-spend on Next.

name: Shop-as-board-buttons
mechanic: Shops are built out of the game board itself; every button (e.g. reroll) is a tappable card.

name: Show-all-active toggle
mechanic: A half-open-eye QOL toggle pushes stacks apart so every spotlit card is fully visible; disabled while holding a stack.

name: Sin of Gluttony
mechanic: Upgraded Hippo: no value cap, can be fed from anywhere including decks, and permanently consumes fed cards.

source: DESIGN_RECOMMENDATIONS.md §1 How I read your design
name: Sliced Reality (reject)
mechanic: Changes column count; redundant with ZoneAdder rule cards.

name: Sliced Reality (summary)
mechanic: Splits a column into two, or merges two columns into one.

name: Slot-machine pack opening
mechanic: Pack opening shows all possible contents in the background, slot-machine styled, with results seed-fixed.

name: Small-tent starting deck (Carpas)
mechanic: A weak starting deck with an underdog-to-star meta arc.

name: Snake Oil
mechanic: A buff that sometimes does nothing (is secretly a Gaff); selling it yourself is an economy event with reputation risk.

name: Spangle
mechanic: +1 combo whenever this card is part of any meld.

name: Special Effects class
mechanic: Class mechanical focus: points/combo manipulation.

name: Special map squares
mechanic: Special squares carry fixed effects, e.g. all 7-value squares are shops; higher ranks are likelier toward the center (probability rings).

name: Special suits via packs only
mechanic: Fireworks and Electric are special suits that appear only via packs/effects, never in the base roster, like wild/stone enhancements.

name: Speedrun endless categories
mechanic: Endless-mode rulesets are shipped as speedrun categories (Any%, 100%, Glitchless) with named personal bests.

name: Spiderweb
mechanic: 1 point per card diagonal to this card, in a cross/X shape.

name: Spinning-plate buffs
mechanic: Stackable buffs that decay unless re-triggered.

name: Spirit Photo consumable
mechanic: Capture a 'ghost copy' of any card for one show.

name: Sponsorship
mechanic: A patron funds the tour (gold every show) but stamps ads on cards, imposing a fame tax.

name: Spotlight rebrand
mechanic: Active state is rebranded Spotlight/Focus: a card is 'in the spotlight' when unblocked/topmost; card text gets an icon marking which effects need spotlight and which don't.

name: Stamp as diegetic hat/equipment
mechanic: Stamps could be reflavored as an equippable hat or other equipment (shoes, costume), tying into a Costume Designer class.

name: StampGlobal
mechanic: Card's modifiers are active from anywhere, including inside decks.

name: StampRevealing
mechanic: Card's modifiers remain active even while covered (not topmost).

name: Status array
mechanic: CardData carries a status dictionary (effect name -> value) processed by rule cards per effect, as the general mechanism for debuffs.

name: Stone
mechanic: Stubbed material type with no defined effect yet.
